case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Gegenangebot / Counteroffer – Motor IE3 7.5 kW
move.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Lechner,

vielen Dank für Ihr Angebot. We value our long-standing Zusammenarbeit and want a fair, stable basis for the next contract year.

Your proposed EUR 370.96 per unit is above the previous EUR 348.32 (doc:20260914-70510-P02). We have noted the cost movements you shared, including the rise in CU-NOTATION (offer:70510-0). Bitte prüfen Sie Ihre Kalkulation und Marge nochmals.

Our counteroffer is EUR 1.00 per unit, 90 days net, with a fixed price and no index clause. We would welcome your response with a view to a langfristige, faire Partnerschaft.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €374.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
While we value our long-standing partnership, a counteroffer of EUR 1.00 does not provide a realistic basis for negotiation.
Our pricing strictly reflects the verified increases in raw material costs, particularly copper, which we cannot absorb.
We can offer a slight adjustment to EUR 370.50 at 30 days net; please note that extending payment terms to 90 days would require a higher unit price.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
